content_of_post_to_answer: How can you shift your mindset from wanting your old life back to building something new after mental health struggles?
answer: Wanting your old life back is often a form of grief, not resistance to change. You may miss the person you were before everything became difficult, including the ease with which ordinary things once felt possible. The shift begins when you stop treating your former self as the standard you must meet. You can honor that life without recreating it. Recovery isn't always a return; sometimes it's learning what kind of life fits who you are now.
